note: CodaBench held-out tasks. Single source of truth for the benchmark, the curriculum generator's ban list, and prepare_data.py's contamination scan. Never copy these tasks, names, or references into training data.

tasks.name: is_palindrome
tasks.description: Return True when text reads the same backward.

tasks.name: average
tasks.description: Return the arithmetic mean of values, or 0 for an empty list.

tasks.name: merge_dicts
tasks.description: Return a new dictionary containing items from left and right; right wins.
tasks.reference:
def merge_dicts(left, right):
    result = dict(left)
    result.update(right)
    return result

tasks.name: rotate_left
tasks.description: Rotate a list left by one position; keep an empty list empty.

tasks.name: is_prime
tasks.description: Return True only when number is prime.

tasks.name: gcd
tasks.description: Return the greatest common divisor of a and b.

tasks.name: flatten_one
tasks.description: Flatten one level of nested lists.
tasks.reference:
def flatten_one(groups):
    return [item for group in groups for item in group]

tasks.name: common_items
tasks.description: Return values that occur in both lists without duplicates.

tasks.name: to_snake_case
tasks.description: Convert spaces and hyphens in text to lowercase underscores.

tasks.name: second_largest
tasks.description: Return the second-largest distinct number, or None if unavailable.

tasks.name: group_by_length
tasks.description: Group strings into a dictionary keyed by string length.
